applicabilityBasis.summary: feUSD is a dollar-pegged CDP token created by users depositing digital collateral. The protocol exchanges feUSD for one dollar of collateral less fees by reducing borrowers' debt positions. Terms do not evidence an issuer obligation to pay national currency or a bank deposit. Dollar stablecoin transferability and collateral-redemption marketing leave the statutory payment-stablecoin issuer/monetary-value limbs unresolved, so applicability is unclear.

genius.notes: Felix Labs Inc is named as a Delaware platform operator, not unambiguously as a legal feUSD monetary-redemption obligor. Terms deny operator control over token creation/destruction but also disclose operator-controlled multisig management of CDP risk/collateral settings, contract maintenance and a 25% fee share. This conflict prevents treating the protocol as conclusively issuerless. issuerEntity and domicile are omitted rather than assigning platform-operator identity to the token. U.S. persons are restricted to view-only access by the terms. This does not prove a foreign issuer or foreign exception and is separate from GENIUS pre-effective DASP posture.
